body.x: Innomaps have presented a solution for MMS-based service in front of 150 guests in the industry and foreign media at the event MIK Innovation Night 2019 on January 10, which was held during CES 2019, the world’s largest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, USA.

Innomaps is a specialized company which provides a solution for MMS-based service, and its main field of business is facility and geographic data collecting device (hardware), development for construction, civil engineering, catastrophe management, and industrial accident management.
It consists of professional employees who have 2D and 3D data collecting skills, navigation skills, image processing skills, and other various knowledge and project experiences.

Nebula-LP is an MMS (Mobile Mapping System) which can be attached to a vehicle and is a FOG type with high precision of inertial navigation system and LiDAR sensor combined. It contains a module for synchronization, arithmetic operation and data collecting operation module.

With its small size and low power consumption, it can be attached to various vehicles; and it can be used directly after connecting the power and DMI. Additional installation of the sensor and camera is provided separately if requested by the customer.

Additional installation of the sensor and camera is provided separately if requested by the customer. Nebula-AP+ contains gimbal, LiDAR, Camera, FOG type INS, data processing and saving operator for level maintenance function, and it only weighs 5kg.

These advantages enable drone in the market to use the high precision 3D facility and geographic data collection. Every feature is controlled through Wifi so that it can focus more on data collection.
